summary: Iteration 4 verified: backend /api/companies/search + /api/companies/ensure + /api/health all pass (7/7 pytest green). Frontend: dashboard CompanyCombobox debounced search returns AAPL with green FILINGS badge, ORCL with warning AUTO-FETCH badge; selecting AAPL shows 'Corpus ready for AAPL', selecting ORCL shows 'No filings yet — we'll fetch...'. All 4 preset tiles render with testids; clicking Bear/Risks updates query textarea and highlights tile. Analyze button correctly disabled without selection+query and enables afterwards. Watchlist section visible (empty then populated). Coverage strip renders ingested tickers as pills. ReportView: Share + Markdown buttons in header, WatchlistStar toggles + persists to localStorage 'alphascribe:watchlist:v1', Markdown download triggered file 'AAPL_Company_name_attach_test.md', follow-up form present, back-to-home navigates to /.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/companies/ensure hardcodes '10-Q' then '10-K' fallback — good, but no timeout guard on fetch_edgar_latest sequential loop; a slow SEC response could delay the request 30-60s. Consider adding asyncio.wait_for.

CompanyCombobox debounce useEffect re-runs on `value` change too (dependency [q, value]) — when a user picks a result, the value updates and the effect fires again with the guard `q === value?.name` to short-circuit. Works but slightly fragile; consider tracking a boolean 'just-picked' instead.

Dashboard.jsx: after ensureCompany success we do not re-check has_filings via a follow-up /companies/search — we optimistically set has_filings:true which is fine for the immediate generate call, but the ticker chip badge remains coloured warning until re-search. Acceptable.
ReportView.jsx: streamJob is reattached on id change; but if SSE dies during a running job we don't retry. Cosmetic — falls back to getReport() on end handler.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data added by tests. AAPL/MSFT/NVDA/TSLA/TSTA/TSTC/ORCL(auto?)/IBM(possibly newly ingested from EDGAR during ensure test) present in db.companies.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter4 tests at /app/backend/tests/backend_test_iter4.py. SEC company index loaded (~10.4k tickers). AAPL/MSFT/NVDA/TSLA have filings; ORCL/IBM were NOT ingested prior to test start — the test_ensure_new_or_404 hit IBM and either 200'd or 404'd. Watchlist LS key: 'alphascribe:watchlist:v1'. Frontend combobox testids: ticker-input, ticker-input-listbox, ticker-input-clear, company-option-{TICKER}. Report header: report-copy-link, report-download-md, back-to-home, watchlist-toggle-{TICKER}, followup-input, followup-submit.
rca of the issue: N/A — all Phase 4 features verified end-to-end.
